level.adolescence.desc: The bridge from child to adult — study, friendship, first love, rebellion. Pass by turning 19.
level.elder.desc: Look back, find peace, leave a legacy. Pass by turning 100.
npc.friend.desc: A friend who grows up with you
npc.partner.desc: The one who knows your heart
ev.kindergarten_show.text: The teacher asks if you want to perform on stage.
ev.kindergarten_show.note.refuse: You shrink into a corner, a little sad.
ev.toy_broken.note.fix: You actually fix it — quite a feat!
ev.toy_broken.note.cry: You wail on; Mom is frazzled.
ev.toy_broken.note.accept: You sigh and learn to let go.
ev.stray_cat.text: A scruffy kitten rubs against your leg.
ev.stray_cat.note.adopt: You gain a furry family member.
ev.stray_cat.note.ignore: You walk on, feeling a pang.
ev.school_bully.text: Someone keeps taking your things and mocking you.
ev.school_bully.note.fight: You brawl; hurt, but you stop fearing him.
ev.school_bully.note.teacher: The teacher steps in and favors you.
ev.school_bully.note.endure: You swallow it, but your heart is heavy.
ev.school_contest.text: The school is recruiting for a quiz contest.
ev.school_contest.note.skip: You keep the time for yourself.
ev.pocket_money.text: You've saved up some pocket money.
ev.pocket_money.note.snack: Sweet in your mouth, bright in your mood.
ev.pocket_money.note.book: You open a book into a new world.
ev.first_friend.text: A kid keeps wanting to play with you.
ev.first_friend.note.approach: You hit it off at once.
ev.first_friend.note.alone: You enjoy solitude and read a lot.
ev.family_trip.text: A family trip full of laughter.
ev.child_sick.text: You catch a fever and feel awful.
ev.exam_cram.text: A big exam looms. How will you spend the night?
ev.exam_cram.note.cheat: You scrape by, but stay on edge.
ev.first_love.note.secret: Secret love is sweet yet bitter.
ev.first_love.note.study: You pour it into your studies.
ev.club.text: Clubs are recruiting. Which will you join?
ev.club.note.literature: You find calm and wisdom in words.
ev.club.note.none: You go solo, a bit lonely.
ev.peer_pressure.text: Friends egg you on to try something you shouldn't.
ev.peer_pressure.note.indulge: You fit in, your body suffers.
ev.peer_pressure.note.refuse: You hold your line, losing some warmth.
ev.peer_pressure.note.report: Praised by the teacher, shunned by peers.
ev.math_olympiad.text: A teacher recommends you for the math olympiad.
ev.family_fight.text: You clash with family over your future.
ev.family_fight.note.talk: You understand each other a little.
ev.graduation.text: At the crossroads of graduation, where to?
ev.graduation.note.university: You take up books toward higher study.
ev.graduation.note.work: You enter society early, earning your first pay.
ev.parttime.text: Someone offers you a part-time job.
ev.parttime.note.take: You earn money, and tire plenty.
ev.parttime.note.decline: You keep the time for study.
ev.interview.note.startup: You set out on the startup road.
ev.interview.note.study: You hone yourself, waiting for the hour.
ev.promotion.text: Your boss hints at a promotion — for more overtime.
ev.promotion.note.accept: More money, less body and mood.
ev.promotion.note.negotiate: You talk your way to better terms.
ev.marriage.text: You and your love reach a turning point.
ev.marriage.note.propose: You vow to share a lifetime.
ev.house.text: You start thinking about where to settle.
ev.house.note.buy: You finally have a home of your own.
ev.house.note.rent: The home is rented, the life is yours.
ev.child.text: You discuss whether to have a child.
ev.child.note.have: A new life makes home loud and warm.
ev.child.note.later: You decide to focus on now.
ev.invest.note.risky: You put money in, outcome unknown.
ev.invest.note.safe: A modest gain, a calm heart.
ev.layoff.text: The company downsizes — you're on the list.
ev.layoff.note.hunt: You soon find a new place.
ev.layoff.note.rest: Your weary body and mind recover.
ev.charity.text: Someone is collecting donations on the street.
ev.charity.note.refuse: You hurry past, a little uneasy.
ev.invest_win.text: You called it right — a big win.
ev.invest_lose.text: The market plunges; the money is gone.
ev.retire.text: You finally set down the burden.
ev.retire.note.travel: You roam the world, grinning like a child.
ev.retire.note.work: You can't sit still, staying busy.
ev.health_scare.text: The checkup isn't good; a decision is needed.
ev.legacy.text: Looking back, what will you leave behind?
ev.legacy.note.memoir: You turn your life into a thick book.
ev.legacy.note.donate_all: You turn wealth into others' hope.
ev.grandchild.text: Your child brings your grandchild to visit.
ev.grandchild.note.spoil: You sneak them some pocket money.
ev.gentle_years.text: The days are plain and peaceful.

level.youth.desc: Into the world — work, love and self-discovery. Pass by turning 35.
level.midlife.desc: Heaviest responsibilities — career, family, health. Pass by turning 60.
ev.new_job_offer.text: After graduating, a job offer lands before you.
ev.new_job_offer.note.decline: You decide to build yourself up first.
ev.hobby.text: You want to take up a hobby.
ev.pet.text: How about adopting a little animal?
ev.pet.note.adopt: A furry member joins the home.
ev.pet.note.no: You shake your head and stay solo.
ev.neighbor_help.text: Your neighbor knocks for a favor.
ev.neighbor_help.note.refuse: The neighbor is a little hurt.
ev.travel.text: You long to see the wider world.
ev.travel.note.stay: You stay in the familiar and rest.
ev.side_hustle.text: Someone pitches you a side gig.
ev.side_hustle.note.focus: You pour yourself into your job.
ev.matchmaking.text: Friends line you up on a date.
ev.accident.text: An accident puts you in hospital.
ev.lottery_win.text: Your offhand ticket hits it big.
ev.mentor.text: The company asks you to mentor a new hire.
ev.mentor.note.self: You keep the time for your own growth.
ev.family_dinner.text: Family invites you home for dinner.
ev.family_dinner.note.attend: The warmth at the table comforts you.
ev.family_dinner.note.absent: Your family is a little let down.
ev.midlife_crisis.text: You start to doubt the life you've built.
ev.adventure_1.note.go: You set off down a path…
ev.adventure_1.note.home: You stay in the safety of home.
ev.adventure_3.text: Exhausted, but the goal is near.
ev.adventure_3.note.persist: You finish the adventure, a hero among friends.
ev.adventure_3.note.give_up: You turn back, a little regretful.
game.perks.title: Perks
action.showoff.desc: Spend 200 for a thrill, hurting reputation
ev.public_good.note.ignore: You slip away; your name suffers slightly.
ev.award.note.decline: You let others have the moment.
ev.help_old.note.pass: You move on, a little uneasy.
ev.online_fame.text: Someone invites you to become an influencer.
ev.online_fame.note.go: Fame tastes sweet — and brings trouble.
ev.rumor.note.ignore: The rumors grow; your name suffers.
world.title: Chronicle of Fate
era.dawn.desc: Fields and hearths; the world is yet a wild, untilled plain.
era.iron.desc: Forge-fires never die; blades and walls redraw the land.
era.steam.desc: Gears roar; for the first time machines run for men.
era.electric.desc: Electric light banishes night; information begins to flow.
era.star.desc: Mankind lifts its eyes to the stars; sky-ports rise above the clouds.
faction.scholars.desc: Wielding knowledge as a blade, they record and explain all.
faction.merchants.desc: They price all things, and set the world in motion.
faction.wardens.desc: Guardians of the long night and order; sworn foes of the Shadows.
faction.shadows.desc: They slip through the cracks of the rules, holding unseen keys.
region.heartland.desc: A rich crossroads of trade; everyone counts carefully.
region.highland.desc: A misty city of learning where seekers watch the stars.
region.harbor.desc: Home of the Wardens; the harbor burns lights all year.
region.wastes.desc: Beyond the rules, where the Shadows take root.
fate.sage.desc: Your pursuit of wisdom awakens; scholarly chances come more often.
fate.tycoon.desc: Your ambition awakens; chances for wealth come more often.
fate.guardian.desc: Your kindness awakens; chances to do good come more often.
fate.rebel.desc: Your defiance awakens; chaotic chances come more often.
fate.scholar_path.desc: The Scholars' Council knows you; academic chances come more often.
fate.star_child.desc: Born in the Era of Stars, the constellations favour you.
codex.title: Codex
lore.first_light.body: They say the world lay in endless night until the first light fell on the Heartland.
lore.iron_pact.body: In the Era of Iron, the four powers swore a pact and drew borders with blades.
lore.steam_rise.body: On the night the first machine roared, the old order began to loosen.
lore.electric_age.body: Current flowed through the cities and the long night was lit for good.
lore.star_gate.body: Star Harbor's first gate opened; mankind looked beyond the sea of stars.
lore.scholars_secret.body: Beneath the Council lies a vault of histories that were edited.
lore.merchant_ledger.body: An old ledger records deals no one will admit to.
lore.wardens_oath.body: 'The long night comes; I shall hold the lamp.' Wardens keep this to this day.
lore.shadows_whisper.body: The Shadows keep no writing; secrets hide in the teeth of a key.
lore.kind_heart.body: Your kindness has spread, a faint light for others.
lore.dark_whisper.body: Your defiance is whispered — and followed in the dark.
lore.wise_one.body: A life of seeking has touched the deep roots of the tree of knowledge.
lore.iron_will.body: Your ambition moves even iron and stone.
lore.traveler.body: You once walked beyond the borders of home and saw a wider world.
lore.grand_design.body: Beneath the sea of stars, you finally grasp the great design of the world.
lore.crowned_rebel.body: The Shadows crown you — a legend born from the cracks of the rules.
ev.iron_forge.text: In the Era of Iron, the town smithy takes apprentices.
ev.iron_forge.note.forge: Sparks fly; you gain a real craft.
ev.iron_forge.note.watch: You watch the flames and feel a little calm.
ev.steam_machine.text: In the Era of Steam, the first loom arrives in town.
ev.steam_machine.note.invest: The machine's roar brings real profit.
ev.steam_machine.note.hands: You keep your craft — and yourself.
ev.electric_night.text: In the Era of Electric, the city's lights stay on all night.
ev.star_port.text: In the Era of Stars, a star-ship waits at the harbor.
ev.star_port.note.voyage: You sail into the sea of stars and see what none have seen.
ev.star_port.note.stay: You watch the ship leave, at peace.
ev.scholars_offer.text: The Scholars' Council hands you a research invitation.
ev.scholars_offer.note.join: You enter the depths of the archive and see true knowledge.
ev.scholars_offer.note.decline: You decline; the Council is a little disappointed.
ev.merchants_deal.text: The Guild asks you to sign a lucrative contract.
ev.merchants_deal.note.sign: Gold in hand; the Guild prizes you more.
ev.wardens_duty.text: The Wardens ask you to join a dangerous night patrol.
ev.wardens_duty.note.accept: You're hurt, but earn the Wardens' respect.
ev.wardens_duty.note.refuse: The Wardens are disappointed by your retreat.
ev.shadows_offer.text: A Shadow offers you a key from the dark.
ev.shadows_offer.note.join: Key in hand, you step into the currents beyond the rules.
ev.shadows_offer.note.refuse: You give the key back; the Shadows note your choice.
pressures.title: Undercurrents — hidden scores
worldev.hard_winter.body: That winter ran long; the fields froze shut.
worldev.famine.body: Years of poor harvests; grain prices soar and the streets fill with the gaunt.
worldev.plague.body: A plague spreads from the harbor; every door is shut.
worldev.war.body: Beacon-fires on the frontier ignite the times; the Wardens call to arms.
worldev.golden_age.body: Trade flows, granaries fill; the streets brim with long-lost cheer.
worldev.renaissance.body: New learning and old craft contend; academies and workshops burn the midnight oil.
worldev.starfall.body: Meteors tear the long night; all look up, filled with unspoken awe.
narr.scene.weather_clear: The sky is clear — a rare bright day.
narr.scene.weather_rain: Fine rain slants down; eaves drip in threads.
narr.scene.weather_storm: A storm beats the window; thunder rolls across the sky.
narr.scene.weather_snow: Snow falls quietly; the world turns white.
narr.scene.weather_fog: Fog creeps over the streets; figures blur a few steps away.
narr.scene.weather_drought: A long drought has cracked the pale earth.
narr.scene.weather_heat: Heat shimmers; even the air seems to bend.
narr.era.era_dawn: In the Era of Dawn, hearth-smoke guards the untilled wilds.
narr.era.era_iron: In the Era of Iron, the forge-fires never sleep.
narr.era.era_steam: In the Era of Steam, the roar of gears replaces the hush.
narr.era.era_electric: In the Era of Electric, the long night is smoothed by lamplight.
narr.era.era_star: In the Era of Stars, eyes begin to look past the clouds.
narr.region.reg_heartland: Here in the Heartland, trade roads meet.
narr.region.reg_highland: Here in the Highland, recitation mingles with mountain wind.
narr.region.reg_harbor: Here in Star Harbor, the sea-wind is salt all year.
narr.region.reg_wastes: Here in the Wastes, even the rules give way.
narr.pressure.nature.hi: The seasons have lost their footing; the sky is fickle.
narr.pressure.nature.lo: Nature is calm; things grow at their own pace.
narr.pressure.society.hi: Voices churn in the alleys; undercurrents swell.
narr.pressure.society.lo: The streets are oddly quiet, as if all held their breath.
narr.pressure.economy.hi: The market hums with coin and crowd.
narr.pressure.economy.lo: Counters gather dust; a chill spreads through trade.
narr.pressure.culture.hi: In schools and teahouses, more talk of new learning.
narr.pressure.culture.lo: Old ways hold, yet a weariness seeps through the pages.
narr.pressure.supernatural.hi: Something whispers at night; the wind carries an uneasy hunch.
narr.pressure.supernatural.lo: The uncanny recedes; the world is plain and clear.
narr.pressure.meta.hi: Hearts brighten with the light, loose and easy.
narr.pressure.meta.lo: The air is heavy; even breathing turns careful.
narr.mood.hopeful: You walk slowly, but you don't stop.
narr.mood.weary: Weariness washes over you in waves.
narr.mood.angry: Yet a fire smolders in your chest.
narr.mood.sorrowful: A weight of gloom sits on your heart.
narr.mood.sick: Your body is heavy; even lifting a hand is a chore.
narr.mood.neutral: The days carry on as usual.
narr.close.1: And so the year slips by.
narr.close.2: You tuck it away in memory.
